title: 帆船甲板假日
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A finished premium pet editorial photograph, not a digital composite. Image 1 is the identity reference only, not a pose or background template. Keep the same adult golden retriever from Image 1, with natural golden coat, floppy ears, dark eyes and black nose. One pet only, no Ragdoll cat, no people. Build a physically coherent location and tell this exact moment: A real small sailboat moored in calm blue water, with striped canvas sail, rope coils and a low safe deck. The pet wears a cream-and-blue sailor collar, sits securely on the deck and gazes toward the horizon with a gentle open-mouth expression. Clear midday light, visible paws and sailboat context, no logos or text. The dog is lying securely on the dry deck with its front paws crossed and chin raised into the breeze, sail and water visible at a believable distance. Frame as a candid eye-level 35mm or 50mm pet photograph with natural optical depth, subtle grain, authentic imperfections and light falling consistently across fur, props and floor. The pet's weight must have believable contact shadows and scale relative to nearby objects. Vertical 3:4, complete pet including paws and tail where visible, safe margins, clear expressive face occupying about 45-60% of frame height. Keep the action obvious even at small thumbnail size. Avoid centered seated studio-portrait pose unless the described action requires it. No floating body, pasted edges, plastic fur, overly smooth render, impossible clothing, extra limbs, duplicate pets, fantasy glow, pseudo-text, logo or watermark. Return one photograph only.
